# M7-S3: a comptime generic expands in an importing package that does not
# import the packages the generic's body names (SPEC Sec 2.5, T-205).
# Package a exports comptime generics whose bodies use strings, sort, and
# strconv; package main names none of the three in source (strconv reaches
# every logos package implicitly, so strings and sort carry the failure:
# without the fix main fails to build with "could not import"). The
# expansion copies the recorded source text of a into main, and the
# compiler opens the copy's packages through main's -importcfg, so the go
# command adds every transitive built package in main's existing action
# graph that main does not import directly, sorted by import path, to the
# import config of main, for build and for lint alike; the same set feeds
# the action ID, so a change in any of those packages rebuilds main. Only
# loGo/s roots gain these synthesized imports; plain-Go roots add nothing.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos list -f '{{.Imports}}' ./main
! stdout '\bstrings\b'
! stdout '\bsort\b'
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^upper \[PORT HOST\]$'
stdout '^ranked \[1:Host 0:Port\]$'
logos lint ./...

# The records name the packages by import path: the __.LOGOS member of the
# archive that logos build writes for a carries one import header per
# package the generic bodies use.
logos build -o $WORK/a.a ./a
go tool pack p $WORK/a.a __.LOGOS
stdout '//logosimp sort sort'
stdout '//logosimp strconv strconv'
stdout '//logosimp strings strings'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/importcfgtest

go 1.27

-- w/a/a.lgo --
package a

import (
	"comptime"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func Upper[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, strings.ToUpper(f.Name))
	}
	return out
}

func Ranked[T any]() []string {
	var out []string
	const for i, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		out = append(out, strconv.Itoa(i)+":"+f.Name)
	}
	sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.StringSlice(out)))
	return out
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/importcfgtest/a"
	"fmt"
)

type Service struct {
	Port int
	Host string
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("upper", a.Upper[Service]())
	fmt.Println("ranked", a.Ranked[Service]())
}
